summary: Improve policy drafting, exception control, and portfolio monitoring. Explore practical credit policy training for lending professionals.
lede: Corporate credit decision-making training helps credit policy analysts, risk managers, and lending professionals translate approved lending rules into daily decisions. Participants practise assessing policy changes, defining underwriting and approval rules, and preparing exception and portfolio-monitoring reports to support consistent lending decisions and management review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who write, interpret, implement, or monitor lending rules. It suits intermediate practitioners familiar with credit decisions, portfolio risk, or lending operations.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of lending decisions, credit risk, or portfolio monitoring is expected. Spreadsheet familiarity is useful. No coding is required.
